required_capabilities: Replace Element Type (×6); Inspect Project (×1); Query Library (×1)
instruction:
The floorplan layout and all room labels are already created in the project. All windows currently have the same size and type. Modify the windows as follows:
- Replace the bedroom window with a Horizontal Multi-Sash Window, 2100× 1500 mm, sill height 500 mm.
- Replace the kitchen window with a Triple Window, 2100 × 1200 mm, sill height 1250 mm.
- Replace the living room window with a Triple Window with Side Transoms, 2000 × 1500 mm, sill height 1000 mm.

windows.label: living room -> Triple Window with Side Transoms 2000x1500
